ship_classes.name: Mule 40
ship_classes.description: Short cab-forward freighter with a rectangular cargo body behind the flight deck. Cheap to operate and easy to park.
ship_classes.reputation: The ship people picture when someone says independent delivery operator.
ship_classes.used_market: Abundant; condition matters more than age.

ship_classes.name: R-88 Roadliner
ship_classes.description: Structural spine with replaceable cargo and service modules. Owners routinely rebuild them into ships Roosevelt never offered from the factory.
ship_classes.reputation: No two used R-88s are really the same ship.
ship_classes.used_market: Strong; clean frame inspections command a premium.

ship_classes.name: R-61
ship_classes.description: Predecessor to the R-88. Less efficient, heavier and blessed with enormous maintenance access.
ship_classes.reputation: Old captains claim the R-61 can be repaired with anything. Mechanics point out that this is because it frequently needs repair.
ship_classes.used_market: Cheap and extremely common on the frontier.

ship_classes.name: Bastion
ship_classes.description: Massive Kesh commercial carrier built around protected tanks and redundant machinery.
ship_classes.reputation: If the cargo absolutely must arrive despite abuse, someone suggests a Bastion.
ship_classes.used_market: High purchase price even at advanced age.

ship_classes.name: Longbeam 900
ship_classes.description: Kilometer-class modular freight spine assembled around drive, power and crew blocks. Cargo clusters attach externally.
ship_classes.used_market: Usually changes hands through finance arrangements rather than ordinary sale.

ship_classes.name: Kite
ship_classes.description: Long-legged lightweight ship optimized for range and low operating mass rather than abuse.
ship_classes.reputation: Loved by careful captains; hated by crews who treat structural limits as suggestions.
ship_classes.used_market: Excellent if maintenance records are complete.

ship_classes.name: Pelican
ship_classes.description: Broad-bodied cargo craft capable of conventional pad operation or water landing.
ship_classes.reputation: Looks wrong in space and completely sensible five minutes after landing on Pelagos.
ship_classes.used_market: Regional; expensive elsewhere due to specialist maintenance.

ship_classes.name: Wayfarer 12
ship_classes.description: An old standardized freighter once produced in enormous numbers.
ship_classes.reputation: Slow, noisy and responsible for more small freight companies than perhaps any other hull.
ship_classes.used_market: Very cheap; parts remain available because so many still fly.
